pair.title: Connect your TimeBox Evo
pair.step_power: Switch the TimeBox on and keep it within 1-2 m of your Homey.
pair.step_close_app: Close the Divoom app and disconnect the TimeBox from any phone or other Bluetooth device. It only accepts one connection.
pair.step_reset: If it was reset or does not show up: switch it off and on again, then wait until the clock/start screen is shown.
pair.step_range: Keep the TimeBox awake (screen on) during the search.
pair.search_note: The search takes up to 60 seconds. If nothing is found, repeat the steps above and search again.

scan.searching: Searching for Bluetooth devices, {seconds} s left...
scan.nothing_found: No TimeBox found. Switch it on, keep it close and awake, then search again. If you renamed it, choose Show all devices.
scan.scan_failed: The search failed ({error}). Check that the TimeBox is switched on, awake and within 1-2 m of your Homey, and that Bluetooth is working on your Homey, then search again.
scan.verify_not_timebox: This is not a TimeBox Evo. Pick another device or search again.
scan.verify_timeout: The device did not answer. Close the Divoom app, make sure the TimeBox is on and awake, then try again.
scan.add_failed: Could not add the device ({error}). Check that the TimeBox is switched on and close to your Homey, close the Divoom app, then try again.

unavailable.unreachable: The TimeBox does not respond. Switch it on, keep it within range and close the Divoom app.
unavailable.not_timebox: This device is not a TimeBox Evo. Remove it and pair your TimeBox again.
unavailable.setup_failed: The TimeBox could not be set up. Remove the device and pair it again, or restart the app.

error.not_connected: The TimeBox is not connected right now. Try again in a moment.
error.not_confirmed: The TimeBox did not confirm the change. Check the display and try again in a moment.
error.text_empty: The text is empty after removing the characters the TimeBox cannot show (such as emoji).
error.text_too_long: The text is too long: {length} characters. The TimeBox shows at most {max} characters (emoji are not counted).
error.countdown_zero: Set a countdown of at least 1 second.
error.invalid_range: {field}: {value} is out of range. Allowed is {min} to {max}.
error.invalid_choice: {field}: {value} is not a valid choice. Allowed are: {allowed}.
error.invalid_color: {field}: {value} is not a colour. Use a hex colour such as #FF8000.
error.invalid_url: {field}: {value} is not a web address the TimeBox Evo app can load. Use an http:// or https:// address of at most {max} characters, without a user name or password.
error.image_unreachable: The image could not be loaded. Check the address and that Homey can reach it (the server must answer within 10 seconds).
error.image_unreadable: The image could not be read from the image tag. Try again, or use another source.
error.image_too_large: The image is too large. At most {max_mb} MB, {max_mp} megapixels and {max_side} pixels per side are supported.
error.image_unsupported: The image cannot be shown. Only PNG, JPEG and GIF images are supported.
error.image_missing: No image was given. Drop an image tag onto the card.
